memberdef.name: ARCH_EXCEPT
memberdef.initializer: do { \ register uint32_t _g1 __asm__("g1") = reason_p; \ \ __asm__ volatile ( \ "ta %[vector]\n\t" \ : \ : [vector] "i" (SPARC_SW_TRAP_EXCEPT), "r" (_g1) \ : "memory" \ ); \ CODE_UNREACHABLE; \ } while (false)

detaileddescription.para: This header contains the SPARC specific kernel interface. It is included by the kernel interface architecture-abstraction header (include/zephyr/arch/cpu.h).
